notes.title: First Gameplay Glimpse of action-RPG, The Lords of the Fallen
notes.content:
[b]Control here, with an urgent message.[/b]

A contract from a distant war-torn region has come through, requesting immediate assistance - proceed with caution. Contract name: The Lords of the Fallen - Gameplay Teaser Trailer. 

Mission directive - Traverse the vast, interconnected world of [i]The Lords of the Fallen[/i]. Engagement of enemy forces has been given the green light, but tread carefully, intel has confirmed reports of hidden forces. 

Watch the new Gameplay Teaser below and wishlist the upcoming dark fantasy action-RPG here. 

[previewyoutube=ab7PYklIGIs;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]A Vast, Interconnected World[/h3]

Embark upon a dark and twisted land split at its very core into two parallel worlds. Only those with the hardiest of constitutions, the most steel of nerves, dare trespass into the nightmarish realm of the dead, where untold horrors lurk and everything is not as it seems… 

       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/78d0f9ff4fe7ac3fb59841da1903ec4c6c8285c0.gif[/img]

[h3]An Expansive RPG Experience[/h3]

You are not alone. Encounter a band of mysterious NPCs, all with their own motivations. Some will help light your way through the darkness, while others serve only their own cruel selves and will seek to sew within you wicked seeds of corruption.

   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/452d09d1b1dde90725695bbb10dfca3bc5d78070.gif[/img]

[h3]Tactical Combat[/h3]

In a land overrun by demons, amid a world plagued by suffering, only those that master the fast challenging combat stand but a hope of survival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/055279fc028b46f7ac270818efe8ed8247c83c3e.gif[/img]

[h3]Devastating Magic[/h3]

Embrace the might of the arcane, rain destruction on all who stumble across your path, or call upon protection from a higher power.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/eb17b7fc82bf96026885b1522d307e223d45d12d.gif[/img]

[h3]Uninterrupted Online Multiplayer[/h3]

Brave your entire quest side-by-side in uninterrupted, online co-op, with fitting rewards for completing community events. But be warned – heroes from other realms can, and will invade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/ace274458fe55661c81878e27237fc25d4b62ab6.gif[/img]

Fully customise your character’s appearance from a wide array of visual options, before selecting one of nine character classes. Whichever starting path you take, develop your character to your own playstyle by upgrading stats, weapons, armour and spells.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849889/c53090b686b92c7c14152899c8e9ed4d576cf7a9.gif[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501750/The_Lords_of_the_Fallen/]Wishlist[/url] [i]The Lords of the Fallen[/i] now for the latest news and updates. For together, we will vanquish the darkness. 

In light, we walk.

notes.title: BEHOLD! THE LORDS OF THE FALLEN, AN ALL-NEW DARK FANTASY ACTION-RPG, UNVEILED
notes.content:
The upcoming title scorched the earth last night when it was unveiled as part of Geoff Keighley’s global gaming event, Opening Night Live. Revealed in the form of a three minute cinematic trailer, it offered viewers their very first glimpse of a world shrouded in shadow and chaos, with narration by the guitar-shredding dungeon master, himself, Joseph Quinn. Bear witness to the moment below…

[previewyoutube=nPGuYZ59NV8;full][/previewyoutube]

The Lords of the Fallen introduces an all-new adventure in a vast, interconnected world, more than five times larger than the original game. An expansive RPG experience - filled with compelling characters, epic boss battles, and rich, immersive narrative - an adrenaline pumping mission awaits!

Keep scrolling below for more information, or if you’ve already heard enough and are ready to take up arms in the name of all that is good, wishlist[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1501750/The_Lords_of_the_Fallen/] here. [/url]

[i]“The Lords of the Fallen is the successor fans of the original title have always wanted,”[/i] said Cezar
Virtosu, Creative Director of Hexworks. [i]“The game is significantly larger, with a vast, interconnected dual world split between the realms of the living and dead, that players can explore alone or with friends. It's darker and more challenging, with faster soulslike combat, stronger thematic, richer narrative, deeper RPG systems, and more immersive storytelling."[/i]

Millennia has passed since the events of the original 2014 hit; the world has plunged into shadow and chaos, as the demon god, Adyr’s resurrection draws nigh. As one of the fabled Dark Crusaders, journey through both the realms of the living and the dead in a thrilling campaign, featuring colossal boss battles, fast challenging combat, memorable character encounters, and deep, immersive storytelling. Will your legend be one of light… or one of darkness?

[b]Explore Two Vast, Parallel Worlds [/b]

From the ethereal heights of Skywalk Bridge, to the decrepit depths of the Shuja swamps, carve your own blood-soaked path through two parallel worlds in an epic quest to overthrow Adyr, the tyrannical, demon god. While the living realm presents its own brutal challenges, untold terrors await in the nightmarish realm of the dead. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/1448c5d0d7cbc574b159fb7359d47dadd2f51620.gif[/img]

[b]Wield a Device of Ungodly Power [/b]

Lantern-bearer, you possess the ungodly power to cross between the realm of the living… and beyond.  Use this dark art to reach forgotten places, unearth fabled treasures, and even purge the very soul of your foe.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/1499d429dd26db066a7f7d8bc92f5711279b1fc5.gif[/img]

[b]Rise from Death[/b] 

Fall in the world of the living, and rise again… in the world of the dead. As a Dark Crusader, you now have one final chance to restore your honour and claim what was lost in your living state. However, this is no easy feat, as all manner of hellish creature descends upon you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/07447d18b3eda0cc414e56ebcbb7714dc730db96.gif[/img]

[b]Unite or Fight in Online Multiplayer[/b]

Adyr’s colossal Lords of Rhogar do not fall easily, but help is at hand for those whose pride permits it. Brave the entire world side-by-side with a loyal companion in uninterrupted, online multiplayer, with fitting rewards for those who complete community quests and events. Though such dealings will render one vulnerable to invasions from heroes of other realms. Art thou the hunter… or the hunted?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/8f1dfa1944e814f2b880bdf21bbb348ba71b918a.gif[/img]

[b]Master Fast, Challenging Combat [/b]

In a land overrun by demons, amid a world plagued by suffering, only those that master the fast challenging combat stand but a hope of survival. Choose from 100s of uniquely brutal weapons, or forgo metal for magic with devastating attacks of the arcane.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/2e0bbf463c90408cc8ecafd3aafd2a79c2f99373.gif[/img]

[b]Fully Customise and Develop Your Own Character[/b]

Fully customise your character’s appearance from a wide array of visual options, before selecting one of nine character classes. Whichever starting path you take, develop your character to your own playstyle by upgrading stats, weapons, armour and spells. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/5c1ec7d33b12fc88acb943504ddbb06f8bec6a9c.gif[/img]

[b]Key Features:[/b] 

[list]
[*] Embark upon two vast, parallel worlds - that of the living… and the dead 
[*] Master a fast, fluid and challenging satisfying tactical combat system 
[*] Wield devastating magic attacks and character buffs
[*] Invite a second player to join your campaign Explore the world side-by-side in uninterrupted, online multiplayer
[*] Encounter a wide array of characters inhabitants, eager to offer a dubious hand… 
[*] Fully customise your own unique character 
[*] Choose from 9 starting character classes, including Knight, Rogue and Fire Apprentice
[/list]

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, The Lords of the Fallen is currently in development for PC and latest-gen consoles. Follow the Steam Page to ensure you’re among the first to hear about all future updates, including a full gameplay reveal later this year.

notes.content:
You’ve been more patient than a professional sniper awaiting that perfect shot. But get ready to pull the trigger, as the wait is finally over… 

As of today, all versions of [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2[/i] will now include ‘Butcher’s Banquet’: a major expansion which introduces an entirely new, unexplored region - The Temple - complete with all-new objectives and some of your most deadly contracts, yet. In addition, today’s patch also added Chinese VO to the main game. Check out the dramatic trailer below…

[previewyoutube=BSWOpPK05oY;full][/previewyoutube]
The stunning desert-like area, made up of luscious oases, dramatic waterfalls, and mysterious temples, might look picturesque, but make no mistake - it’s no holiday destination. Following the recent turmoil in Kuamar, a new threat has been allowed to surface. The movement is led by the notorious Mahmoud Zarza... aka ‘The Butcher’. Unpredictable and incredibly dangerous (hence the monika), we need you to eliminate him and his equally-lethal associates, and in doing so, put a stop to the faction's rapid uprising… as only you know how. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/8de3ae82835f569ebe0cf2a1d8a14e800043d094.png[/img]

For those of you who haven't yet picked up [i]Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2[/i], get 25% off now for a limited time only as part of Steam's Midweek Madness offer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/79a2ea6d7d349826216818e14265d9ee0fee8379.png[/img]

notes.title: SGW Contracts 2 - V1.03 - HUD Customisation, Game Improvements & More!
notes.content:
Greetings, snipers!

With today’s update, we’re introducing several killer adjustments and improvements to the game. Here’s what we’ve done:

[h3]Added various HUD customization options, so you can now:[/h3]
[list]
[*] disable all HUD elements completely - great for taking screenshots and admiring the games beauty
[*] disable the wind indicator & bullet drop in your scope
[*] disable the map / enemy radar found in the bottom left corner of your screen
[*] disable hitmarkers
[*] disable gore independently from blood
[/list]
[h3]Difficulty changes
[/h3]
[list]
[*] Automatic health generation on 'Dead Eye' difficulty has been disabled
[*] Automatic health generation on 'Sniper Veteran' difficulty has been slightly decreased
[/list]
[h3]Challenges[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved displaying challenge descriptions in all supported languages
[*] The "Kill everyone in the village without raising the alarm and rescue Taj Taheer" challenge is now unlocked properly, even after loading the game
[/list]
[h3]Other improvements, tweaks & bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The game will now indicate when an enemy spotter sees you with their binoculars, similar to snipers
[*] Removed one enemy in the Mount Kuamar region that sometimes spawned inside walls. You're a free man again Gary!
[*] AI will recognise the player quicker in close range
[*] AI will react faster to grenades thrown
[*] Enemy AI should no longer spawn in the player's field of vision on rare occasions.
[*] The Road in Ronald Payne's outpost no longer flickers during Bullet Cams
[*] Improvements to ambient audio in caves
[*] Improvements to various player animations
[*] Fixed various instances in which a player could get stuck between objects
[*] Jammers and spotlights functionality has been made more consistent
[*] Fixed rare issue in which part of the Mount Kuamar region was not being loaded properly
[*] Additional performance and stability improvements
[*] Various bug & typo fixes.
[/list]
If you have any problems with the update, don’t hesitate to contact us at support@cigames.com.

While you’re at it, make sure to share your amazing screenshots with us on [url=https://twitter.com/SGWContracts]Twitter[/url] and on our [url=https://discord.gg/SGW]Discord.gg/SGW[/url].

Thank you again for playing!

Watch your six, and keep an eye out for patrols.

notes.title: Prepare for your Next Assignment with Two New Soulslike Titles
notes.content:
Greetings, snipers!

If punishingly brutal combat is your idea of a good time, then prepare for your next assignments...

Part of the CI Games family, United Label will be releasing two gruellingly-difficult soulslike titles this year; [i]Tails of Iron[/i] and [i]Eldest Souls[/i], as announced during the E3 Future Games Show. Find out more info on both below! 

[h2]Tails of Iron[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567116/539681587a04b2467787175e3b8c46a7193e2af8.png[/img]

[i]Tails of Iron[/i] is an epic RPG Adventure with a focus on formidable foes and challenging combat. As Redgi, heir to the Rat Throne, you must embark on a perilous quest to reclaim your Kingdom. Explore a deceivingly charming world. Assemble a band of brave companions. Banish the merciless Frog clan!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567116/9e9a265789dc2ead42bee15a0172a1548cdaf6fb.png[/img]

From frog zombies to gargantuan grubs - and everything in-between - the Kingdom is awash with danger. To overcome each perilous encounter, you’ll need to study your opponent’s attacks and react accordingly! Thankfully, there’s a range of deadly abilities at your disposal, including parry bashes and fatal executions, not to mention ranged attacks with your nifty bow and arrow.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283410/Tails_of_Iron/]Wishlist it on Steam now! [/url]

[previewyoutube=IYr3jtdLKeQ;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1283410/Tails_of_Iron/

[h2]Eldest Souls [/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567116/acf5cf9697e4444593eb954363cf78f68217c28a.png[/img]

Fast-paced and defiantly difficult, [i]Eldest Souls[/i] is a unique Boss-Rush soulslike experience. In a final act of vengeance, the Old Gods have unleashed a great Desolation upon the world. Mankind's only hope lies with a lone warrior… and his greatsword of pure Obsidian.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6567116/6386e1f78a3827b6a3e3e7b204e1cb272858c411.png[/img]

notes.title: OUT NOW! SGW Contracts 2 Releases Today Alongside SHROUD DLC
notes.content:
Snipers, it’s finally time to take up arms and prepare for mission deployment. Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 is OUT NOW!

The newest entry in the best-selling first person sniping franchise, this eagerly awaited sequel promises to take the series to new heights (and lengths!) with a host of new features, not least of all, the further-than-ever extreme-range sniping. With many targets now over 1000m away, the dramatic single player campaign promises to challenge even the most proficient of FPS players! 

[i]Calibrate the distance. Adjust for windspeed. Allow for bullet drop. 
[/i]
[i]Now breathe. And squeeze the trigger. [/i]

[previewyoutube=0fXL6t-PzFE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]The Story[/h2]
Step into the military boots of Raven, Sniper Assassin, as he embarks on a new series of contracts in a lawless region of the Middle East, located along the Lebanese and Syrian borders. Tasked with a seemingly impossible task, your mission is to topple an insidious criminal syndicate led by the region’s corrupt President, Bibi Rashida.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/177a6e7393ae78a6a951a5718624e050e9a0b651.png[/img]

[h2]Customise your Arsenal & Explore 5 Extensive Regions[/h2]

Guided by advanced intel, you’ll need to navigate 5 distinct sandbox-style regions in order to complete 21 varied (but equally lethal) contract targets. To aid you in your assignment, you’ll have access to the most powerful Sniper Rifles in existence, able to take out hostiles with utmost precision, as well as a wide selection of pistols, assault rifles, and shotguns, not to mention a variety of gadgets and explosives to boot. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/d30e9b81f9450deefe1df55ee3ed2a002e364780.png[/img]

[h2]Plan your approach[/h2]
With every contract posing its own unique challenge, you’ll need to fully customise your loadout to ensure it's optimised for the job at hand. Missions can be completed in a number of ways, with a series of rewards for achieving all objectives. Earn cash and experience points to upgrade your arsenal, unlock new skills… and ultimately, become the Ghost Warrior! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/f56a19bf8af773866e7e8fafd9ab34f0231a5625.png[/img]

[h2]shroud DLC[/h2]
Also launching today is the first in a series of influencer-themed DLC drops. Top FPS streamer, shroud, has worked with the studio to create his very own DLC package, containing an exclusive Sniper Rifle, tuned to his unique style of play, in addition to a branded weapon skin. Zoom in for a closer look at the exclusive pack here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38748078/acda7bc7b67feccb519d35620053e0765162894e.png[/img]

[h2]Out Now - Standard and Deluxe Editions[/h2]

Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 is out now! And if you fancy getting an upper hand on your enemy, make sure you check out the Deluxe Edition, containing an array of high power firearms:

[list]
[*] [b]ZXR .45 ACP[/b] - As well as the only silenced SMG in the game, the ZXR .45 ACP also shoots the biggest rounds, making it one powerful addition to your arsenal.
[*] [b]Kings Arms Sawn Off Shotgun[/b] - The only shotgun to go into the sidearm slot, usually reserved for pistols - a very tempting trade-off.
[*] [b]Giovanni Mk12 Auto [/b]- The only silenced shotgun in game. The enemy won’t know what hit it.
[*] [b]Prescot SR-9 Pistol[/b] - Fitted with the best silencer in-game, this is a must for close-quarter tactical combat.
[*] Fire and Ice Weapon Skin
[*] Paint Spill Weapon Skin
[*] Round Geometrical Painted Weapon Skin
[*] Dark Hex Camo Weapon Skin
[*] Graffiti Weapon Skin
[*] Dark Sky Skin
[/list]

SGW Contracts 2 is a tactical, modern warfare shooter set in the Middle East. Play as Raven, Contract Sniper Assassin, as you take out a series of targets across a dramatic single-player campaign. With extreme long-range shots exceeding 1000m, gear up for the most thrilling entry to the series yet.

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings Snipers! [/h2]


[h3]Get ready to cast your scopes on your [b][u]very FIRST LOOK[/u][/b] at Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 with our brand-new Gameplay Reveal Trailer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=17fqzmlwqyw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h3]SGW Contracts 2 elevates the series to  new heights - and distances! - with its 1000m+ extreme-range sniping feature. As contract sniper assassin, Raven,  you must utilize a selection of authentic gear and equipment across large-scale sandbox maps in order to track and eliminate a range of targets… by whatever means necessary. Snipe from afar, or infiltrate silently. Anything but failure is an option. 


[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] 1000m+ extreme-range sniping
[*] A dramatic single-player campaign set in modern day Middle East
[*] 5 distinct sandbox maps featuring a variety of fully accessible, interactive areas you can approach your own way
[*] Next level realism with authentic gadgets and weapons fully customizable to fit different styles of play
[*] Replayable missions that can be completed in a number of ways, with unlockable rewards for achieving all objectives
[*] More intelligent adversaries with improved tactics
[*] Enhanced visual and game engine, setting a new benchmark for the series
[/list]
[/h3]
[h2][b]Releasing on 4th June 2021, don’t miss a beat (or headshot!) by WISHLISTING NOW![/b][/h2]
